### Living Free
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/living-free
Passage: Romans 6:5-7
Points:
- Many believers continue to live like fearful captives rather than walking in freedom.
- Union with Christ in His death has stripped sin of its ruling authority over the believer.
- God's abundant grace gives Christians the capacity to live above sinful compulsions.
- True Christian maturity means expecting and enjoying liberation rather than defeat.
- Believers are called to stop making excuses and boldly embrace their spiritual emancipation.

### Alive in Christ - The Crosswalk Devotional - January 28
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/alive-in-christ-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Romans 6:11-12
Points:
- Faith in Jesus fundamentally changes a person's standing, ending their slavery to sin.
- Knowing we are alive to God motivates us to honor and obey Him with our lives.
- Christ possesses the transforming power to redeem anyone, no matter how deep their past rebellion.
- Resisting sin requires actively avoiding settings and habits that trigger temptation.
- Victory comes through leaning on prayer, biblical truth, and the support of fellow believers.

### Christ Did Not Ascend into the Realm of Mere Religious Ideas
Author: Alex Crain
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-march-23-2010-11627851.html
Passage: Romans 6:11
Points:
- Christ was raised historically in real time and space, not as an abstract philosophical idea.
- The believer's union with Christ's death breaks the world's power to dictate their thinking.
- Counting oneself dead to sin means resting in Christ rather than worldly approval or possessions.
- The Christian life centers on ongoing communion with God in every circumstance.
- Daily faithfulness begins with being spiritually alive to God's presence each moment.
